name: Jacksonville
tagline: Beach Living, No State Income Tax, and Florida's Most Affordable Major City
description: Jacksonville is Florida's largest city by area, offering miles of Atlantic beaches, a revitalizing downtown, and some of the most affordable housing in the Sunshine State. With no state income tax, a growing food scene in the Five Points and Riverside neighborhoods, and easy access to both St. Augustine and Amelia Island, Jacksonville is an underrated FIRE destination that combines beach-town living with big-city infrastructure.

quickFacts.visa: No visa required for US citizens
quickFacts.climate: Subtropical with hot humid summers and mild winters

housing.description: Cheapest-acceptable 1BR in Arlington or Murray Hill

dining.description: Casual seafood shacks and taco spots a few times a week; mostly cooking at home

healthcare.description: ACA marketplace Silver plan on the FL federal marketplace, subsidized if MAGI is kept under the 2026 400%-FPL cliff (~$62,600 single); assumes an early retiree (45–55) — above the cliff, premium tax credits vanish and this line climbs toward ~$1,000/mo

transportation.description: A paid-off used car with insurance and gas; a car is essential in sprawling Jacksonville and FL auto premiums run high

entertainment.description: Beach days, Riverwalk strolls, free concerts, pier fishing

1M.lifestyle: A cheapest-acceptable one-bedroom in Arlington or Murray Hill, cooking most meals at home with casual seafood shacks and taco spots a few times a week. A car is essential across Jacksonville's sprawl, and Florida's high auto premiums plus summer A/C bills form a real cost floor alongside the ACA Silver premium — which stays affordable only if MAGI is managed under the 2026 ~$62,600 cliff. Florida's zero income tax helps, and the Atlantic beaches, Riverwalk, and pier fishing are free and close.

2M.lifestyle: A decent one-bedroom in San Marco or Avondale, or a condo near Jacksonville Beach, with dining out several times a week and weekend brunch culture. A reliable car with full FL coverage covers day trips to St. Augustine and Amelia Island, and there's room for Jaguars games, a gym, and surfing gear. Florida's zero income tax keeps the full withdrawal intact, making for a comfortable beach-adjacent life.

3M.lifestyle: A high-quality place near the beaches or a waterfront one-bedroom in San Marco or Ortega, with regular dinners at Restaurant Orsay, Town Hall, and Cowford Chophouse. A late-model SUV, premium care through Mayo Clinic Jacksonville, and golf access near TPC Sawgrass all fit, with healthcare a Gold plan padded near the ~$62,600 ACA cliff. Jacksonville's affordability means this budget covers more ground than the same money in South Florida.
